title: Big Daddy
recommended: NORMAL • 5★ • 608 notes • 14 SPACE • Song choreography v17.4.44

direction_profile.notes: All note directions were re-authored from a per-song movement grammar. FLAC-derived timing, note types, Reverse placement, SPACE timing, and note counts are unchanged.
direction_profile.readability_note: No retained direction was changed; only selected overloaded ordinary-note slots were removed.

chart_design.principle: Lossless-source onset evidence selects subdivisions; phrase energy controls density; calm sections keep breathing room and payoff sections escalate.
chart_design.timing_rule: Verified BPM grid with FLAC-driven phase refinement; no free-running timestamp drift.
chart_design.difficulty_rule: NORMAL is readability-first: clear first-read phrasing, frequent recovery, no inherited HARD difficulty cliffs, and Reverse remains an introduction rather than a primary pressure source.
chart_design.reverse_rule: Reverse remains difficulty-scaled (~6% / ~12% / ~18%) but is relocated away from the fastest local clusters whenever safe slots exist.
chart_design.readability_rule: Telemetry-confirmed HARD overload slots are removed when they also exist as ordinary NORMAL notes; retained timestamps/directions, all Reverse notes, and all SPACE events are unchanged.
chart_design.direction_rule: Each song owns a deterministic movement grammar derived from its FLAC-timing rhythm fingerprint and section form. No global fixed direction motif bank or cyclic motif index is used.
chart_design.direction_guardrails: No same-direction spam, no immediate repeated 2–12-note blocks, no 4+ clockwise/counter-clockwise perimeter walks, and no three-step repeated translation vector.

difficulty_standardization.policy: Remove NORMAL notes that coincide with telemetry-confirmed HARD overload slots. Keep all Reverse and SPACE events.
